newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MOSTLY WEAKER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MOSTLY WEAKER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Monday's interbank session weaker against hard currencies, pushed down by unexpected import pressure.
"The dollar lost one and a half cents during the day on the back of a little bit of import pressure which came at a time when the market was short," a dealer said.
"It came as a bit of a surprise during this time of the year when most companies are still closed (after Christmas)," he added.
He said the local unit dipped to a 10.8350/8550 low against the key U.S. dollar before the central Reserve Bank intervened to inject some foreign currency into the market.
The Zimbabwe dollar stabilised at 10.8300/8500 against the U.S. money, a two cent drop from last Friday's 10.8100/8300.
Against pound sterling, it was quoted at 18.2860/3260 compared to 18.1000/1200 and was at 2.3130/3200 against South Africa's rand, down from 2.3100/3300.
The currency however edged up marginally to 6.9540/9690 against the German mark from 6.9600/9700.
